english: 15-18. They wore the (prescribed) simple guise. They bowed down to him. (Becoming) sinless, they followed him for the sake of attaining Śiva’s favour. The knowledge in the Jñānapāda of Puṣkarāgama[1] is prescribed. Brahmā duly performed the sacrifice of the Crescent-crested Lord. Keeping the Dīkṣā procedure in view and in order to bless them, he made the Devas do everything sincerely.
